title: Quick Italian Pasta Pesto with Thai Chili Jam and Dashi
description: A rich snappy hangover cure pasta that blends fresh basil pesto, smoky Thai chili jam, and savory dashi for an Emilia-Romagna twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti for 8 minutes or until al dente.
While the pasta cooks, wash the basil leaves and pat them dry.
In a food processor, combine basil, pine nuts, olive oil, Parmesan, chili jam, dashi extract, and water; pulse until a smooth paste forms.
Drain the cooked spaghetti, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water.
Toss the hot spaghetti with the pesto, adding reserved pasta water a tablespoon at a time until the sauce coats the noodles.
Season with a pinch of salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving bowl and drizzle with extra olive oil if desired.
Garnish with a few whole basil leaves or a sprinkle of pine nuts for texture.
Serve immediately, accompanied by a glass of chilled white wine.
Enjoy the comforting savory flavor that lifts the spirits after a long day.
